item.title: 132 Drivers Arrested In Drink & Drug Drive Crackdown
item.description: Over 130 people were arrested on Leicestershire’s roads during December’s police drink and drug drive campaign. 85 drivers failed roadside breath tests, 35 were found to be under the influence of drugs, and 12 refused to provide a sample. 47 arrests followed a collision, with 24 people taken into custody during daytime checks. item.title: Police Constable Charged With Rape
item.description: A Leicestershire police constable has been charged with two counts of rape and one count of assault by penetration. Stephen Reynolds, 28, of Leicestershire, is suspended from the force and remains on police bail. The charges relate to incidents reported to have taken place in 2019 and involve an adult female victim known to Reynolds. […]

item.title: Harborough Charity Celebrates £10,000 Lottery Boost
item.description: A Market Harborough-based charity is celebrating after securing £10,000 from the National Lottery Community Fund. Hab Anti-bullying and Mental Health will use the funding to train volunteers and boost its counselling grants. item.title: Job Fears After High Street Chains Enter Administration
item.description: Jobs are under threat in Lutterworth after the Original Factory Shop was placed into administration, alongside high-street chain Claire’s. More than 2,500 jobs are at risk after owner Modella Capital said last-ditch efforts to save the businesses had failed. item.description: Plans to redevelop a former social club in Kibworth Beauchamp are facing growing opposition.
